title: Silence for the Siren
tagline: The textbooks call sirens monsters. Senna hasn’t said a word in seven years.
blurb:
Senna Reese hasn’t spoken in seven years. The first siren ever admitted to Luminara Academy, a school of crystal and enchanted stone on a mountain in Aethermoor, she talks in ASL and through a choker her twin brother built to give her thoughts a voice.

The textbooks call sirens monsters. Lars McNeil, vampire son of a powerful Council family, makes her a target on her second day. Raine Murdoch, a dark elf, hasn’t stopped watching her since she arrived.

Her silence is protecting something. And something old is waking inside her.
pov: First person, present tense, multiple POV
content_warnings: This is a dark bully romance. A full, detailed content warning list is coming.
